name: Simple AJAX WooCart
author: Guru IS

sections.description:
Enhance Your WooCommerce Store with Simple AJAX WooCart

Simple AJAX WooCart is a powerful, lightweight, and user-friendly plugin designed to improve your WooCommerce store’s shopping experience. With this plugin, you can add a sleek, customizable floating cart icon to your website, enabling users to view their cart contents and manage items effortlessly.

The plugin leverages AJAX technology to provide real-time cart updates without the need for page reloads. This ensures a seamless and engaging experience for your customers, leading to higher conversions and customer satisfaction.

Key Features:
* Floating Cart Icon: A stylish and responsive cart icon is always visible, making it easy for customers to access their cart.
* Real-Time Updates: AJAX-powered cart ensures that changes are reflected instantly without reloading the page.
* Customizable Design: Choose from various cart icons, shapes, colors, and sizes to match your store’s branding.
* Cart Item Count: Display the total number of items in the cart with customizable font size and colors.
* Positioning Flexibility: Place the cart icon at the bottom left or right of the page and adjust margins to fit your layout.
* Mobile-Friendly: Fully responsive design ensures compatibility across all devices.
* Intuitive Admin Panel: A simple and organized settings page allows you to customize the cart icon and behavior with ease.

Benefits:
* Improved User Experience: Customers can manage their cart seamlessly without leaving the current page.
* Increased Engagement: With easy access to the cart, customers are more likely to complete their purchases.
* Brand Consistency: Customize the cart’s look and feel to align with your store’s design.
* Quick Setup: Get started in minutes with a straightforward installation and setup process.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simple-ajax-woocart/ directory or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the settings page under the ‘WooCart Settings’ menu to customize the cart icon and behavior.
sections.faq:
1. Can I customize the look and position of the floating cart icon?

Yes, the plugin offers a variety of customization options. You can choose the icon shape, size, color, padding, position (left or right), and margins to fit your store’s design. These options can be configured through the plugin’s settings page.

2. Does the cart update in real-time without refreshing the page?

Yes! The plugin uses AJAX technology to ensure that the cart updates in real-time whenever items are added, removed, or modified. This provides a seamless shopping experience for your customers.

3. Is the Simple AJAX WooCart plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The plugin is fully responsive and works smoothly on all devices, including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

4. What happens if I disable the plugin?

Disabling the plugin will remove the floating cart icon from your store. However, it will not affect the core functionality of WooCommerce or the cart itself. Customers can still access their cart through standard WooCommerce pages.
